reconcile.note: Fausset reads the evil Isaiah says God creates as calamity and disaster set against peace, not the moral evil of sin condemned elsewhere in scripture.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Dan Barker catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Dan Barker, God: The Most Unpleasant Character in All Fiction (2016).

sides.snippet: I make peace, and create evil
sides.verseText: I form the light, and create darkness; I make peace, and create evil. I am Yahweh, who does all these things.
He who doesn't love doesn't know God, for God is love.
